description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityComparisonOperator' for comparison operations within the OFBiz entity framework, including methods for SQL generation, comparison logic, and pattern matching.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: Abstract class for comparison operators in entity conditions, supporting SQL generation, comparison logic, and pattern matching.

methods.name: makeOroPattern
methods.description: Creates a Perl5 regex pattern from a SQL LIKE pattern string.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates SQL-related components of the comparison.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Appends SQL representation of the comparison to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the comparison operands are empty.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereString
methods.description: Constructs the RHS part of the SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: makeRHSWhereStringValue
methods.description: Constructs the RHS value part of the SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Abstract method to compare two operands.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison in a given context.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the operands match given a data map.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable or cached version of the operands.

methods.name: compareEqual
methods.description: Static method to compare equality of two Comparable objects.

methods.name: compareNotEqual
methods.description: Static method to compare inequality of two Comparable objects.

methods.name: compareGreaterThan
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is greater than another.

methods.name: compareGreaterThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareLessThan
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is less than another.

methods.name: compareLessThanEqualTo
methods.description: Static method to check if one Comparable is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: compareIn
methods.description: Static method to check if a value is in a collection or equals another value.

methods.name: compareLike
methods.description: Static method to check if a string matches a pattern.
